item.name: smooth-scroll
item.summary: page-provider: Lenis provider stepped strictly via useFrame with autoRaf false (dom, server-safe, singleton, reduced motion -> off, mobile -> off)

useWhen: Marketing landing pages requiring unified cinematic scroll feel
Editorial feature stories paired with sticky scroll narratives
Desktop viewports with fine pointers and high-refresh displays
avoidWhen: Forms-heavy pages and modal-only checkout flows

alternatives.name: native-scroll
alternatives.when: When standard browser compositor scrolling is sufficient without kinetic interpolation

tiers.0: Disabled completely; native browser scrolling only
tiers.1: Disabled on coarse pointers and touchscreens; native touch momentum preserved
tiers.2: Standard smooth inertial scrolling stepped strictly via useFrame
tiers.3: High-precision smooth scrolling with fine pointer optimization

reducedMotion.description: Disabled completely; 100% native platform momentum scrolling.

input.pointer: Wheel and keyboard events mediated via Lenis on fine pointers
input.touch: Native touch momentum scrolling 100% preserved; Lenis is inactive on coarse pointers
input.keyboard: Full support for Space, PageUp, PageDown, Arrow keys, Home, and End

a11y.notes: Native keyboard scrolling is fully preserved. When reduced motion is preferred, smooth scrolling is turned off completely, delegating all scroll behavior to the native platform compositor.

props.name: children
props.effect: Child components wrapped inside the smooth scroll provider.

props.name: smoothWheel
props.effect: Whether to interpolate mouse wheel deltas.

props.name: enabled
props.effect: Master toggle to enable or disable smooth scrolling.

props.name: onScroll
props.effect: Callback invoked synchronously on every scroll update.

props.name: prevent
props.effect: Predicate to bypass smooth scrolling for specific nested DOM elements.

mistakes: Do not mount multiple SmoothScroll instances; SmoothScroll is a singleton provider.
Do not import Lenis directly or create separate requestAnimationFrame loops.
Do not use on dashboards, forms-heavy pages, or data-dense web applications.
verify: Verify keyboard navigation (Space, PageUp/Down, Arrows) works identically to native scrolling.
Verify hash anchors (#section-id) jump smoothly without layout offsets.
Verify reduced motion disables Lenis and returns 100% control to the platform.
